data.gender_notes: Saharuk is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The One Who Has The Power Of The God Indra
data.long_meaning: Saharuk is a name derived from Sanskrit and Hindi language. It is a compound name, composed of two words, saha meaning 'with' and ruk meaning 'power'. The name Saharuk signifies 'The One Who Has The Power Of The God Indra'. Indra is the Hindu deity of rain, thunderbolts, and the warrior god of the Vedic pantheon. In Hindu mythology, Indra is the king of the devas (gods), and he is often depicted as the wielder of the thunderbolt, the lord of the heavens, and the god of rain.
data.spiritual_meaning: Saharuk is a name that evokes the power and strength of the Hindu deity Indra. It is a name that inspires courage and bravery, and it is a name that is believed to bring protection and prosperity to those who bear it.
data.etymology: Saharuk belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One Who Has The Power Of The God Indra.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saharuk total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
